Raise a Concern

100Ls Shadowing Material · M3-04 · EP17  ·  职场英语：提出顾虑  ·  8/17–8/22
📄 Full Script — Dialogue
0:00 / 0:00
速度：
Jordan
Sam, do you have a minute? I want to flag something before it becomes a bigger issue.
Sam
Sure, go ahead.
Jordan
I'm a bit concerned about the timeline for the client demo. We're still missing two key features, and the deadline is Friday.
Sam
That is tight. What's your take—can we scope it down?
Jordan
I think we'd have to. Otherwise we risk shipping something that feels incomplete.
Sam
Fair point. Let's get the team together this afternoon and figure out what's realistic.
Jordan
That works. I just didn't want this to catch anyone off guard.
Sam
No, you're right to bring it up early. That's exactly what we need.
Jordan：Sam，你现在有空吗？我想在问题变大之前提一件事。
Sam：当然，说吧。
Jordan：我有点担心客户演示的时间进度。我们还缺两个关键功能，但截止日是周五。
Sam：确实很紧张。你觉得呢——我们可以缩减一下范围吗？
Jordan：我觉得有必要。否则我们可能会交付一个感觉不完整的东西。
Sam：说得对。今天下午我们把团队召集起来，看看什么是实际可行的。
Jordan：好的。我只是不想让这件事让任何人措手不及。
Sam：不，你提早说是对的。这正是我们需要的。

📚 Key Vocabulary & Phrases
flag
/flæɡ/
v
标记，提出（问题）
🔗 常见搭配
flag sth flag an issue flag a concern
💬 例句
I want to flag something before it becomes an issue.
我想在问题变大之前提出来。
Please flag any risks you see in the plan.
请标出你在计划中看到的任何风险。
🔄 近义表达
highlight raise point out
timeline
/ˈtaɪmlaɪn/
n
时间线，进度计划
🔗 常见搭配
tight timeline timeline slips meet the timeline
💬 例句
I'm concerned about the timeline for the demo.
我对演示的时间进度有些担心。
The project has a very tight timeline.
这个项目的时间计划非常紧张。
🔄 近义表达
schedule deadline roadmap
scope down
/skəʊp daʊn/
phr.v
缩减范围，降低功能预期
🔗 常见搭配
scope it down scope the project scope back
💬 例句
Can we scope it down?
我们可以缩减一下范围吗？
We had to scope down the feature set for launch.
我们不得不缩减上线的功能集。
🔄 近义表达
scale back cut scope simplify

/kætʃ ɒf ɡɑːd/
phr
让人措手不及，出其不意

🔗 Connected Speech
do you have
/djuːv/ → "d'ya have"
T+Y-coalescence + Reduction
"do you" 快速连读成 /djuː/ 再缩减为 "dya"，典型美式口语，"do" 的 /d/ 与 "you" 的 /j/ 融合。 类似：would you → "wouldja", did you → "didja"
want to
/ˈwɒnə/ → "wanna"
Want+to Reduction
/t/ 弱化消失，"to" 缩减为 /ə/，极常见的非正式语速连读，口语中几乎无处不在。 类似：going to → gonna, have to → hafta
a bit concerned
/əbɪt kənˈsɜːnd/
Schwa + Linking
"a" 弱读为 /ə/，与 "bit" 连读无间隙，整体轻读。强调落在 concerned 的第一个音节。 类似：a bit tired, a bit late, a bit worried
get the team
/ɡɛðə tiːm/ → "getha team"
D+TH-assimilation
"the" 中 /ð/ 与前面 /t/ 发生融合，快速语流中 "get the" 听起来像 /gɛðə/，两词连读无停顿。 类似：put the → "puttha", set the → "settha"
bring it up
/ˈbrɪŋɪdʌp/
Linking + T-flapping
"it" 的 /t/ 在两元音之间弹舌变为 /d/，三个词连成一组流畅短语。整体发音接近 "bringiddup"。 类似：pick it up → "pickiddup", look it up → "lookidup"
